seo.title: Destrava Currículo: find what holds your resume back and fix it with AI
seo.description: Upload your resume, see your score and find out what is holding it back before a person reads it. Get AI improvement suggestions and download the ready version.

hero.subtitle: Many companies use a robot to filter resumes before a person reads them. Upload yours, see what is holding it back and fix it in minutes, with suggestions that sound like you.
hero.badgeBuiltByEngineers: Made by people who've been there

features.sub: From upload to a ready file: upload, see what holds you back, fix it and download. No hassle.

atsScore.title: Resume score
atsScore.desc: A 0 to 100 score with the detail of each part: job keywords, formatting, results and clarity.

aiRewrite.title: AI improvement suggestions
aiRewrite.desc: Turns weak sentences into results with numbers. You review and approve each one. No generic "led" and "leveraged".

keywordOpt.title: Compare with the job
keywordOpt.desc: Paste the job description and see exactly which words the robot expected and did not find in your resume.

versionHistory.title: Saved versions
versionHistory.desc: Every version is kept, with its score, one click away. You never lose a good version.

diffComparison.title: What changed
diffComparison.desc: Compare two versions line by line and see what changed and how the score reacted.

analyticsDashboard.title: My dashboard
analyticsDashboard.desc: Track your score, the job keywords you already cover and the problems you solved with each version.

pdfExport.title: Download your resume
pdfExport.desc: Your resume rebuilt in a clean template that the screening robot reads without errors.

howItWorks.sub: It takes a few minutes. You upload the file and we show the way.

upload.title: Upload your resume (PDF or DOCX)
upload.desc: Drop the file. In seconds we read everything and look for what usually holds resumes back: formatting, missing job keywords, weak verbs and confusing dates.

analyze.title: See your score and what is holding you back
analyze.desc: You get a 0 to 100 score, the 5 most important problems, the 5 strengths and improvement suggestions for each weak spot.

download.title: Apply the fixes and download it ready
download.desc: Review and click "Apply" on the suggestions you like. Save a new version, download the PDF and apply.

dashboardPreview.title: From resume to interview, no mystery
dashboardPreview.sub: See your progress with each version and tailor your resume to each job in a few clicks

benefits.title: Stop being ignored. Start getting answers.
benefits.sub: What changes when your resume stops getting stuck.

callbacks.title: Fix it before you are silently rejected
callbacks.desc: Many resumes never reach a person. We show what usually gets blocked by the automatic filter, like formatting, missing job keywords and weak verbs, and help you fix it.

parsed.title: The robot reads your resume without errors
parsed.desc: We show how the screening robot sees your file and point out what it cannot read. No formatting tricks, no hidden text.

bullets.title: Sentences with results, not filler
bullets.desc: Strong verbs, results with numbers and your own voice. Compare "managed project" with "Led a team of 4 and shipped 12 features per quarter".

apply.title: Tailor your resume to each job
apply.desc: Paste the job description, see what is missing, adjust and download. Then apply to other similar jobs.

keywords.title: Stop guessing what to include
keywords.desc: Paste the job and we highlight the words your resume does not have, and where it makes sense to add them.

cta.subtitle: Get your score, the problems holding you back and improvement suggestions. It takes a few minutes.
cta.ctaSecondary: Already have an account? Sign in

footer.tagline: Your resume, unlocked for the next opportunity.
